description: The text of one observed snapshot — by version number, or the snapshot LexAPI held on a date (YYYY-MM-DD). This is what LexAPI had fetched then, NOT the law in force on that date; dates before the document entered the corpus return 404. Cost: 1 credit.

date.description: Return the snapshot current on this date (end of day UTC).

language.description: Language: ISO 639-1 code of an official EU language (en, fr, de, …; default en).

offset.description: Continue after a truncated response (value given in its note).

view.description: auto: the body if it fits maxChars, else an outline. full: body up to maxChars, then offset to continue.

name: lex_get_document_version
title: A document snapshot by version or date
